tasks.subject: Task 1: AppShell + Sidebar Navigation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a persistent dark left sidebar replacing per-page headers.

**Files:** src/components/AppShell.tsx (create), src/components/Sidebar.tsx (create), src/app/dashboard/page.tsx (modify), src/app/product/[id]/page.tsx (modify), src/app/settings/page.tsx (modify)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Sidebar visible on all authenticated pages
- Active nav item highlighted based on route
- Logout works from sidebar
- Content area scrolls independently

**Verify:** Navigate to /dashboard, /product/:id, /settings — dark sidebar present with correct active state.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/AppShell.tsx", "src/components/Sidebar.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Sidebar on all pages", "Active state correct", "Logout works"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Dashboard Tabs + Top Opportunities Panel
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Split dashboard into Overview/Products tabs with Top Opportunities panel.

**Files:** src/components/Dashboard.tsx (modify)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Two tabs: Overview and Products
- Overview: PortfolioStats + two-column grid (chart + opportunities)
- Top Opportunities shows raise/lower products sorted by delta
- Products tab unchanged

**Verify:** Switch tabs on /dashboard — both render correctly, no console errors.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/components/Dashboard.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Both tabs render", "Opportunities panel shows"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Export CSV
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Export all products as CSV from dashboard header.

**Files:** src/app/api/products/export/route.ts (create), src/app/dashboard/page.tsx (modify)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- GET /api/products/export returns text/csv
- Export button in dashboard header downloads file
- Columns: sku, title, current_price, cogs, margin_pct, recommended_action, suggested_price

**Verify:** Click Export CSV — browser downloads priceiq-products.csv with correct data.
